files.made: Written by bench.py when aspmc runs (run_aspmc), from the ProbLog program of the same name: the same model, as aspmc is given it. Evidence is asked as queries, bench_e :- E. and each query Q as bench_qe_Q :- Q, E., E the conjunction of what the program observes, so that P(Q | E) is P(bench_qe_Q) / P(bench_e); a probability in exponent notation is written out, the same double; and V is X is written V = X, as aspmc's grammar reads them. Written only where one of these changes the program.
